description: This file contains Scala code implementing utilities and converters for handling Avro data within Apache Spark, including functions to convert Avro IndexedRecords and Wrappers to Java Maps, and methods to unpack various Avro schema types.

classes.name: AvroConversionUtil
classes.description: Utility object providing methods to convert Avro data types to Java objects.

classes.name: IndexedRecordToJavaConverter
classes.description: Converter class to transform Avro IndexedRecord into Java Map.

classes.name: AvroWrapperToJavaConverter
classes.description: Converter class to transform AvroWrapper objects into Java objects.

methods.name: fromAvro
methods.description: Main method to convert an Avro object to a corresponding Java object based on schema type.

methods.name: unpackRecord
methods.description: Converts an IndexedRecord to a Java Map.

methods.name: unpackMap
methods.description: Converts an Avro Map to a Java Map.

methods.name: unpackFixed
methods.description: Converts an Avro Fixed type to a byte array.

methods.name: unpackBytes
methods.description: Converts various byte representations to a byte array.

methods.name: unpackArray
methods.description: Converts an Avro Array to a Java Collection.

methods.name: unpackUnion
methods.description: Handles Avro union types, resolving to the actual data type.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Method to convert an IndexedRecord to Java Map in IndexedRecordToJavaConverter.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Method to convert an AvroWrapper to Java object in AvroWrapperToJavaConverter.
